text.autoconfig.changelog363.title: 363Changelog Config
text.autoconfig.changelog363.option.chan: URL of the remote changelog JSON file. Must return raw JSON, not a GitHub web page
text.autoconfig.changelog363.option.pack: Modpack display name in the bottom-left of the title screen
text.autoconfig.changelog363.option.show: Show the changelog button on the title and pause screens
text.autoconfig.changelog363.option.load: Seconds to wait for the remote changelog before falling back to cache/bundled. The load never blocks game entry; this only bounds how long the changelog UI can show "loading" (20-120)
text.autoconfig.changelog363.option.vers: Distance in pixels between the version text and the bottom of the title screen
text.autoconfig.changelog363.option.exte: Display name of the external link
text.autoconfig.changelog363.option.feed: Show the feedback button on the changelog overview screen
Placeholder text of the feedback field
API token. GitHub: personal access token (repo scope). Gitee: personal access token. Sent as Bearer (GitHub) / access_token (Gitee)
